blocks.text: Level examination A2
Instructions
The examination checks the objectives of the Level A2 in five skills. It takes place in the week 94, in two half days:
• day 1: A · Read (50 minutes), B · Listening (35 minutes), C · Language (35 minutes);
• day 2: D · Scripture (60 minutes), E · Oral with tutor (about 18 minutes).

rows: Reading: alarm, email or partially vocalized tale, voiceless titles
Listening: voice message, dialogue, news, dictation
Language: verbs, derived and passive forms, complex phrases, numbers and comparison, Egyptian
Oral: reading aloud, conversation, story, role play, report a news

blocks.text: Overcoming. At least 70 points above 100At least 12 points (60%) in each section and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings (Sections D and E). Before we start.
• Section B requires someone to read. Delivery to another person the page "Exam Script"
at the beginning of the exam solutions (Part IV), or paste the scripts into the voice synthesis app without reading them.
• Section E requires a native language tutor: pronunciation does not evaluate itself. Without tutor the section remains in suspended and the examination is not concluded.

• Work without notes, Anki and dictionary. Write in Arabic with short vowels, except where it is otherwise indicated. Just correct it at the end. What the result attests. A pass says you mastered the program. A2 of this course. It is not a CEFR certification, even if the reference level is A2. For external feedback in front of an independent examiner, the end of theA2 is the recommended time for the CIMA of the Institute du monde arabe (Piano, section 6.4; Appendix C). If you don't pass the exam. Identify the sections below the minimum and follow the recovery path (table at the bottom of the solutions) for 2–4 weeks. Then repeat only those sections with Version B, at the end of this exam: don't look at it first. If you fail the same section again, repeat the module that contains it.

blocks.text: D · Scripture (20 points)
Write in Arabic with short vowels. You can use real or invented data. D1 · A module (4 points). Fill out the registration form for an office for foreigners. Half a point per field.
⁧المِهْنَةُ⁩

D2 · A message (4 points). Write to Karīm a message of about 40 words. You must: 1. wish him well for his sister's wedding; 2. tell him that in the spring you can't go to Morocco, and why; 3. propose the summer;
4. Ask him to send you pictures of the party. A point for each element present and understandable.
D3 · A text (12 points). About 150 words. Choose one of the two themes.

• Theme a · A formal email. Write to the Secretariat of the Arabic Language Centre in Milan (notice A1) for enroll in the course: submit, indicate your level, the dialect you have chosen and why, ask two questions, indicate the attachments, close formally.

• Theme b · A day I will not forget. Tell a special day of your life: the background, what It happened, who was there, what someone said, how it ended. Mandatory elements: one related; a sentence with ⁧أَنَّ⁩ or ⁧إِنَّ⁩ ; a subordinate ( ⁧عِنْدَمَا⁩ , ⁧إِذَا⁩ , ⁧قَبْلَ أَنْ⁩ …); a number written in letters; three verbs of derived form. The theme a requires the formulas of the formal letter (A2-22); theme b at least three ⁧كَانَ⁩ + imperfect and a speech reported. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 (×2) + Register 1–4. Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy, up to a minimum of 1.

The room has a problem (air conditioning does not work, there is noise): explain it and ask to change room; Then ask for a taxi to the airport in the morning and check. The tutor is the clerk. Assessment (heading 6.3): Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Understanding 1–4 + Speak 1–4 + Register 1–4.
